title_fil: Kagamitan, suplay at talaan ng BHS
objectives_fil: Ihambing ang aprubadong lokal na standard sa aktuwal na serbisyo at iulat ang tiyak na puwang sa responsable.
Gamitin ang lokal na checklist, itala ang item, kondisyon at may pananagutan, at iulat ang kulang o sira.
Bilangin muli, itala ang petsa at kondisyon, at sundin ang reconciliation process kasama ang supervisor.
Sundin ang kasalukuyang device at infection-control guidance sa paglilinis at pagtatabi; iulat ang sira sa responsable.
I-update ang stock card mula sa aktuwal na resibo at issue, sundin ang aprubadong pag-aayos, at iulat ang expired o sirang suplay.
objectives_en: Given a local BHS profile, compare actual services with the approved checklist and identify a gap to report.
Given the visually verified source list and local standard, check equipment presence, condition and responsible staff.
Given a sample room and inventory sheet, reconcile items and document one discrepancy.
Given a training device and reviewed manufacturer/local protocol, demonstrate cleaning, storage and fault reporting.
Given fictional receipts, issues and expiry dates, update a stock card and flag storage/expiry problems.
summary_fil: Kagamitan, suplay at talaan ng BHS: 5 aralin na may kaso, pagsasanay at observer sheet.
summary_en: BHS equipment, supplies, and records: 5 lessons with cases, practice and observer sheets.
